say:2:1430335501:1.text: Well, because it's no longer a secret. It has something to do with the Divine Dew.
say:2:1430335501:1.source_cn: 因为他被赶走的原因终于不是秘密了！莱恩被贵族赶走的原因...

say:3:1430335502:1.text: Yeah, I heard that the Divine Dew was made up of dragon egg essence. Drinking too much will cause your body to gain the traits of a dragon...
say:3:1430335502:1.source_cn: 我听说恩典灵露就是龙蛋清，喝多了身体会产生龙化……

say:4:1430335503:1.text: That's right. Rion was banished because he saw his master with a veil.
say:4:1430335503:1.source_cn: 没错！莱恩被赶走就是因为他看见贵族面纱下的鳞片！
